programs.title: Management and Economics
programs.summary: This pathway leads to a number of degrees at Royal Holloway in fields related to management and economics. Discover modules you will study and degrees this pathway leads to.

programs.title: Sciences - Engineering, Physical and Mathematical
programs.summary: This pathway prepares you for science-related degrees at Royal Holloway. Explore the modules in this pathway and degrees you can choose when you progress.

programs.title: Sciences - Life Sciences and the Environment
programs.summary: This pathway prepares you for science-related degrees at Royal Holloway. Explore the modules in this pathway and degrees you can choose when you progress.

programs.title: Social Sciences, Arts and Humanities
programs.summary: This pathway prepares you for a variety of Royal Holloway degrees related to social sciences, arts and humanities. Find out what you will study and what progression degrees you can choose from.

programs.title: Business and Management
programs.summary: This pathway will prepare you to join one of many business-based degrees at Royal Holloway. Learn more about progression options and what studying business and management can do for your future.

programs.title: Economics
programs.summary: This pathway aims to prepare you to progress to one of three economics degrees. Explore the progression routes offered at Royal Holloway and whether studying economics is suitable for you.

programs.title: Electronic Engineering
programs.summary: This pathway will give you the necessary key skills for progression to an electrical engineering-based degree. Find out more about this programme and how to progress to study at Royal Holloway.

programs.title: Computer Science (Cyber Security & AI)
programs.summary: Designed to prepare you to study computer science with AI, cyber security and software engineering specialisms at Royal Holloway. Discover more about this programme and how you can progress to study at Royal Holloway.

programs.title: Business and Management
programs.summary: This pathway leads to a wide range of business-based Masters degrees at Royal Holloway. As a part of this programme, you will study topics such as marketing, digital innovation and international management.
